# ffxf_vm_actions (Data Source)

Lists account-wide actions or actions for one virtual machine, with optional account-wide status filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_vm_actions" "example" {
  vm_id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `status` (String) Filter account-wide actions by status when vm_id is omitted.
- `vm_id` (Number) Limit results to a virtual machine. Omit to list account actions.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (Attributes List) Matching VM actions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--actions))

<a id="nestedatt--actions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `actions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Action creation timestamp.
- `error` (String) Action failure message, when available.
- `finished_at` (String) Action completion timestamp, when available.
- `id` (Number) Action ID.
- `source` (String) Action origin, API or console.
- `started_at` (String) Action start timestamp, when available.
- `status` (String) Action status.
- `type` (String) Action type.
- `vm_id` (Number) VM ID associated with the action, when known.
